name: Shackleton region
note: IAU/USGS feature centre of Shackleton crater (LOLA control network). Regional marker, not a historical touchdown or a selected safe landing point.

name: Connecting Ridge region
note: NASA published Shackleton Connecting Ridge SCR2 candidate coordinate from its 2021 selection record; not the eventual IM-2 touchdown.

name: Malapert massif region
note: IAU/USGS centre of Mons Malapert, also called Malapert massif. Regional marker, not the IM-1 touchdown.

name: Mons Mouton region
note: IAU/USGS centre of Mons Mouton. Regional marker, not a historical touchdown.

name: Chandrayaan-3 · Shiv Shakti
note: Rounded published touchdown coordinate. Southern high latitude, not the geographic south pole. Coarser 240 m terrain.

name: Apollo 11 · Tranquility Base
note: Historical near-equatorial comparison. Global LOLA terrain is approximately 1.9 km/pixel, unsuitable for local landing hazards.
